messages:
aisha: FYI Catalyst just messaged — APAC H200 lead time bumped from ~2w to ~8w. We have 12 pending allocations in the APAC pool. :eyes:
ben_ops: Ugh. Is this across-the-board or just specific SKUs/serial ranges? Any RMA impact?
catalyst_ops: Confirmed — wafer shortage impacting H200 line for APAC allocations. Options: 1) cross-ship from EU pool (3wk transit + customs), 2) staggered partial shipments (6/12 now, rest later), 3) expedite air (quote below). RMAs: we can fast-track DOAs within 48h for impacted customers.
maria_prod: Can we do an interim swap with EU dedicated pool while they transit? What's the cost delta for cross-ship vs air?
catalyst_ops: Cross-ship sea/road est cost delta: ~$800/unit (includes customs brokerage). Air expedite: ~$2.5k/unit, ~5 business days door-to-door. We can prioritize packing and manifesting for your PO if you confirm by EOD.
sven_planning: Quick impact calc: if we pull 8 units from EU to APAC now, APAC shortage reduces to 4 units. 8 * $800 = $6.4k addl cost; air for the remaining 4 at $2.5k = $10k => total ~$16.4k. If we air all 12: 12 * $2.5k = $30k. Need tradeoff vs SLA & loss of EU buffer.
aisha: Good breakdown. @ben_ops can you check our EU spare buffer and whether Dedicated customers will tolerate temporary re-routing? Also confirm any customs paperwork lead time.
ben_ops: On it. I'll ping infra-procurement and legal re: ETAs for temporary reassignments. If Catalyst can prioritize RMAs for DOAs, that reduces business risk.
maria_prod: Also flagging cost to finance — will need pre-approval for expedite > $15k.
aisha: If EU pool can't spare 8 units, propose we air 4 as a triage (top 4 priority customers), cross-ship 4, hold 4 for scheduled arrivals. @sven_planning can you rank the 12 pending by priority?
sven_planning: Will push a ranked list in the spreadsheet and mark top-4 for air.
ops-bot: Created ticket TKT-4521 to track: Vendor Catalyst APAC lead-time spike. Tasks: procurement PO amend, customs docs, EU-to-APAC manifest, expedite payment approval. ETA updates will be posted here.
aisha: Pls attach vendor AWB quote and manifest when available. Also request Catalyst send RMA SLA in writing (48h commitment) so we can update support runbook. :pray:
catalyst_ops: Will send formal quote + RMA SLA doc in 2 hours. I included a quick AWB sample below for planning:
```
AWB: 123-CHT-000987
Pieces: 4
Gross weight: 320kg
Service: AIR_EXPRESS
ETA (door): ~5bd
```
ben_ops: Thanks — I'll start the PO amendment draft and loop finance/legal. Will post update TKT-4521 when done.
aisha: Perfect. Keep this thread for vendor updates only — I'll spawn a follow-up with customer comms draft once we lock numbers.
